# Preparation
```{r}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsankey) # remotes::install_github("davidsjoberg/ggsankey")
library(ggtext)
library(showtext)
library(ggimage) # for geom_image / flag rendering
library(magick)

# ── Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- read_csv("data/exhibitors_cphijp2026.csv")

unique_ex <- df %>%
  mutate(
    flag_url = paste0(
      "https://hatscripts.github.io/circle-flags/flags/",
      country_code_lower,
      ".svg"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    company_name,
    country,
    country_code_lower,
    flag_url,
    region,
    show_type
  ) |>
  mutate(
    country = case_when(
      country == "RUSSIAN FEDERATION" ~ "RUSSIA",
      country == "SOUTH KOREA" ~ "S.KOREA",
      TRUE ~ country
    )
  )

top_countries <- unique_ex %>%
  count(country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12) %>%
  pull(country)

# ── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
font_add_google("Alata", "title_font")
font_add_google("Noto Sans", "body_font")
showtext_auto()

# ── Palettes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
country_colors <- c(
  "JAPAN" = "#BC002D",
  "CHINA" = "#DE2910",
  "INDIA" = "#FF9933",
  "ITALY" = "#009246",
  "TAIWAN" = "#000095",
  "USA" = "#3C3B6E",
  "S.KOREA" = "#003478",
  "RUSSIA" = "#D52B1E",
  "SWITZERLAND" = "#FF0000",
  "DENMARK" = "#C60C30",
  "HONG KONG" = "#DE2910",
  "GERMANY" = "#FFCE00"
)

# [CHANGE 2] Region palette — assign distinct colours per region
region_colors <- c(
  "Asia" = "#4E9AC7",
  "Europe" = "#5BAD6F",
  "North America" = "#E07B39",
  "South America" = "#C97BC7",
  "Middle East" = "#D4A842",
  "Africa" = "#7B5EA7",
  "Oceania" = "#3ABFBF"
)

# Combined fill palette (countries + regions; show_type keeps grey)
all_fill_colors <- c(country_colors, region_colors)

# ── Build Sankey data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sankey_df <- unique_ex %>%
  filter(country %in% top_countries) %>%
  make_long(country, region, show_type)


unique_ex |>
  filter(country == "CHINA") |>
  count()
# japan  163, china 202

# ── [CHANGE 1] Flag label data: replace country text labels with flag images ───
# We'll overlay flags on the Country node positions using geom_image.
# Compute per-node y positions after the plot is built via a label data frame.
# ggsankey exposes node positions; we extract them from the sankey_df structure.

# Build a flag lookup: country → flag_url
flag_lookup <- unique_ex %>%
  filter(country %in% top_countries) %>%
  distinct(country, flag_url)

# Node label data for country column only (x == "country")
country_label_df <- sankey_df %>%
  filter(x == "country") %>%
  distinct(node) %>%
  left_join(flag_lookup, by = c("node" = "country"))

# ── [CHANGE 4] Title with 50 % facts ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Example facts you'd derive from your data (adjust numbers to actual values):
# e.g. "Japan leads with 38 % of exhibitors; 60 % participate in both show types"
title_text <- "Most Japanese Exhibitors Focus on the Ingredients Segment at CPHI Japan 2026"
subtitle_text <- "Top 12 countries by exhibitor count. Each stream shows the flow of\nunique exhibitors from country through region into show segment."
caption_text <- "Source: CPHI Japan 2026 Official Exhibitor List "
```



#  Plot 
```{r}
# ── Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p2 <- ggplot(
  sankey_df,
  aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = node
  )
) +

  geom_sankey(
    flow.alpha = 0.55,
    node.color = "white",
    smooth = 6,
    width = 0.08
  ) +

  # Restore text labels for ALL columns including country
  geom_sankey_label(
    size = 3.8,
    color = "white",
    fill = "grey25",
    family = "body_font",
    hjust = 0.5,
    label.r = unit(3, "pt"),
    label.padding = unit(3, "pt")
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = all_fill_colors,
    na.value = "grey75",
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "country" = "Country",
      "region" = "Region",
      "show_type" = "Show Type"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = title_text,
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    caption = caption_text
  ) +

  theme_sankey(base_family = "body_font", base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      color = "grey20",
      margin = margin(t = 6)
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "title_font",
      face = "bold",
      size = 24,
      color = "grey10",
      lineheight = 1.2,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      family = "body_font",
      size = 14,
      color = "grey35",
      lineheight = 1.4,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      family = "body_font",
      size = 9,
      color = "grey55",
      hjust = 0, # 0 = left, 0.5 = centre, 1 = right
      vjust = 1, # vertical nudge relative to plot edge
      margin = margin(t = 14)
    ),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(24, 40, 16, 40)
  )

p2

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
showtext_opts(dpi = 320)
ggsave("assets/cphi_sankey_bump.png", p2, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 108)
showtext_auto(FALSE)


# ── Canvas dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_width <- 1080L
plot_height <- 1080L

# ── Read base plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_img <- image_read("assets/cphi_sankey_bump.png")
base_img <- image_resize(base_img, paste0(plot_width, "x", plot_height, "!")) # force exact 1080x1080

# ── Read & resize logo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
logo_img <- image_read("logos/wide/satom-wide-color.png")
logo_target_width <- round(plot_width * 0.15)
logo_img <- image_scale(logo_img, as.character(logo_target_width))

logo_info <- image_info(logo_img)
logo_width <- logo_info$width
logo_height <- logo_info$height

# ── Position: bottom-right ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
margin_right <- 10
margin_bottom <- 10

x_offset <- plot_width - logo_width - margin_right
y_offset <- plot_height - logo_height - margin_bottom

# ── Composite & save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
final_img <- image_composite(
  base_img,
  logo_img,
  offset = paste0("+", x_offset, "+", y_offset)
)

image_write(final_img, "assets/cphi_sankey_1080x1080.png", format = "png")

```
